description: ARIO: Automated Reconnaissance Image Organizer is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Shirley Dyke, Purdue University (purdue.edu). The Automated Reconnaissance Image Organizer (see link above) is an AI-based tool to rapidly organize post-event images collected by reconnaissance teams. In just a few minutes, our tool, a sort of "Netflix for Disaster Images" can organize thousands of images and make a structured inspection report for a concrete building to support reconnaissance teams. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-krz5-ej22. Keywords: reconnaissance, earthquakes, concrete buildings, machine vision, classification. Published 2022-12-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
